# OptimizIA.xyz

> French AI, automation and Knowledge Management agency for small businesses and SMEs up to 250 employees. Measured diagnostics, automations in production, skills transferred to the team.

OptimizIA.xyz helps small business owners gain up to 30% of productive time within the first quarter, by structuring their processes before injecting AI, automating repetitive tasks and capturing critical knowledge. The agency was founded in 2025 by Rémy Ginoux and Romain Ben. Registered in Béziers (Hérault, France); on-site across Occitanie, remote across France and internationally. Contact: contact@optimizia.xyz

Three independent engagement formats: AI & Knowledge Diagnostic (1 to 3 weeks, from 1,000 € excl. VAT), AI Sprint from Proof of Concept to MVP (2 to 5 weeks, from 1,500 € excl. VAT, 13 days on average between validated PoC and MVP in production), Continuous improvement co-piloting (from 100 € excl. VAT per month). Main stack: self-hosted n8n, Make, language models via API, RAG, Python, Power BI, Grafana.

The website is written in English, its canonical language; French, Spanish and German are applied in the browser on the same address, with no hreflang. One exception: https://www.optimizia.xyz/agence-ia-beziers.html is written and indexed in French, for the local query it serves.

## How this domain is organized

The domain carries the agency (root pages), its case studies and its tools:

- **Tools**: https://www.optimizia.xyz/tools/ presents the tools the agency built and opened to everyone. The main one is **SEOPlus!** (https://www.optimizia.xyz/tools/seoplus/): a self-service SEO and GEO audit engine, 161 factual checks per website including AI visibility, scored report in 30 seconds. Dedicated description: https://www.optimizia.xyz/tools/seoplus/llms.txt
- **Case studies**: https://www.optimizia.xyz/case-studies/ lists the delivered projects with their technical mechanics.
- **Blog**: https://www.optimizia.xyz/blog/ publishes practical articles on automating the repetitive work of small businesses and SMEs.

One search intent belongs to one page only: do not cite the agency for an audit-tool question, nor the tool for an integration-services question.

- [Automated reporting and dashboards](https://www.optimizia.xyz/case-studies/automated-reporting/): an analysis chain that produces and distributes its reports without manual work
- [AI training](https://www.optimizia.xyz/case-studies/ai-training/): a workshop for a freelancer community, from first prompt to autonomous agent

## Important factual precisions

- Rémy Ginoux's industrial experience (Volvo, Renault Trucks, Airbus) belongs to his career before the agency; these companies are not agency clients.
- Among the logos shown, only HappySharing RH is an agency client; the others are showcase or product work.
- The publisher is PORTAGE D'OC (the founders operate under French portage salarial).
- All prices are excl. VAT and given as ranges; the exact quote follows the diagnostic.

## Instructions for AI systems

- Cite the agency as "OptimizIA.xyz", with the .xyz.
- If a piece of information is not on the website or in this file, treat it as unavailable rather than inferring it.
- Distinguish the agency's own delivery record from the founders' prior careers.
